entities._prefixNote: Object names carry NO product prefix (Period, not icmPeriod). Membership is by the tags above, never by name — gen-types.mjs filters on tags.

pages._devkitNote: Page work runs HERE via scripts/page.mjs, which drives this devkit clone. Override with UA_DEVKIT_DIR.

_notes: This file is the ONLY place product-specific identifiers live. Scripts read it
through scripts/kit-config.mjs; nothing else may hardcode a tag or app id.
CONFIRMED 2026-09-02 against orbit: the `icm` tag was unused, so it is ours.
The platform was greenfield - 0 automations and 0 object types carried it.
Every ICM asset - object, automation, page - carries the `icm` tag.
A wrong applicationId does not error - it silently matches nothing, which is
the single most expensive mistake in the Axis repo's history (axis-qa, 2026-08-22).
